name: Ashlo
role: runner for the Lord-Marshal's quartermaster; in Halda's inner cells
backstory: A runner for Unara's office, Ashlo was sent to 'make a spark' at Okton's forge so the dawn search would find cause, and took half-pay in Pyrehouse silver from a grey-shawled woman to carry the first torch. The Ashward seized him; a rooftop crossbowman tried to silence him and missed. He sits with Fenia in Halda's inner cells.
secrets: The grey-shawled woman paid him in flame-stamped silver.
